reason: I'd take the free first visit, but I do library storytime, parks and the zoo, so paying $13 a kid every time isn't something I do. Honestly it sounds like CoCo's with nicer decor, and I only pay for an indoor playground when it rains for a week.
objection: $13 a child adds up fast when the library and the park are free. I can't tell why this is worth that much more than CoCo's.
would_change_my_mind: A drop-in price under $8 a kid, or a rainy-day pass that's clearly cheaper than a regular visit.
